name: Network Denial of Service
description: Adversaries may perform Network Denial of Service (DoS) attacks to degrade or block the availability of targeted services to users, including SYN flood, UDP flood, and distributed volumetric amplification.

name: Active Scanning: Port Scanning
description: Adversaries may execute active port scans to discover open ports, listening services, and system connectivity states across the target network topology.

name: Brute Force
description: Adversaries may use brute force techniques to attempt credential guessing or systematic authentication bypass on SSH, FTP, and web admin services.

name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
description: Adversaries may attempt to exploit vulnerabilities in internet-facing services or web applications, including SQL injection and Heartbleed memory disclosure.

name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: JavaScript
description: Adversaries may execute malicious client-side JavaScript payloads or cross-site scripting (XSS) vectors targeting authenticated sessions.

name: Compromise Infrastructure: Botnet
description: Adversaries may leverage infected nodes forming a botnet command-and-control mesh (such as Ares or Mirai) for distributed traffic generation and staging.

name: Valid Accounts & Infiltration
description: Adversaries may exploit compromised internal credentials to infiltrate subnets and move laterally across privileged application tiers.

name: Exploitation for Privilege Escalation
description: Adversaries may exploit local kernel or service vulnerabilities to escalate privileges from standard user to root / administrator (U2R).

name: Unclassified Suspicious Network Activity
description: Generic fallback classification for high-confidence anomalous traffic patterns not explicitly matching defined signature taxonomies.
